clue.text: A light coming from amidships

parts.note: a beam is a shaft of light

explanation.surface: A lamp shines out from the middle of a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: On a ship, a bearing at right angles to the keel points out level with the vessel's middle section.

clue.text: Undoubtedly the trendy thing to do

parts.note: something in fashion is said to be in
a deed is an act, a thing done

explanation.surface: Someone insists that a certain activity is unquestionably fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are emphatic adverbs of agreement meaning certainly or truly.

clue.text: Dead bark-the result of wintry days

parts.note: a dead body is cold
to snap is to speak sharply, to bark at someone

explanation.surface: Dead tree bark is what a hard winter leaves behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the result of' just links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A short spell of sudden chilly weather brings a run of frosty days.

clue.text: Fears to stray into the hills

indicators.note: the stray word goes into the word for hills, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: tors are rocky hills, as on Dartmoor
to err is to wander or go astray

explanation.surface: Someone is afraid of wandering off into the hills.
explanation.walkthrough: TORS are rocky hilltops on English moors such as Dartmoor.
explanation.definitionFit: Terrors are intense frights, so the plural noun matches plural anxieties.

clue.text: Only a little bacon and egg for children

parts.note: only a little amount is small
a fry, or fry-up, is a cooked breakfast of bacon and eggs

explanation.surface: Kids get just a modest plate of bacon and egg.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'fry' or 'fry-up' is the British cooked breakfast of fried bacon, eggs and so on.
explanation.definitionFit: Small fry is an idiom for young kids or unimportant people, from the term for young fish.

clue.text: Bet armour can be forged from wood

indicators.note: forging metal hammers it into a new shape, so these letters are reshaped into another word

explanation.surface: Someone wagers that a suit of armour can be made out of timber.
explanation.definitionFit: An arboretum is a collection of planted trees, a kind of woodland grown for study.

clue.text: Finished appearing in a musical group and left

indicators.note: the word for finished shows up inside the band phrase, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a band is a musical group, with the article giving A
something finished is done

explanation.surface: A musician has quit after a final gig with a group.
explanation.definitionFit: Something abandoned has been deserted, left behind by its owner.

clue.text: An NCO cunning and astute

parts.note: SM is short for sergeant major, a senior soldier ranking below officers
art can mean craft or cunning, as in artful

explanation.surface: A sergeant described as wily and shrewd.
explanation.definitionFit: Both adjectives describe someone clever and quick-witted.

clue.text: Spare container filled with hydrogen

indicators.note: the container holds the other piece, which goes inside it

parts.note: a tin is a metal container
H is the chemical symbol for hydrogen

explanation.surface: A spare canister has been charged with gas.
explanation.definitionFit: Spare as an adjective means lean or slight in build.

clue.text: Shrub supplied by the French retailer, we hear

indicators.note: says the phrase is to be heard spoken rather than read as spelt

parts.note: la is French for the, and a vendor is a seller

explanation.surface: A bush is sold by a shopkeeper from France, apparently.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an aromatic flowering bush grown for its scented purple blooms.

clue.text: The way in which to incorporate everything and make it sacred

indicators.note: the word for the way takes in the other piece, holding it within

parts.note: how means the manner or way in which
all means everything

explanation.surface: A method of embracing the whole world and sanctifying it.
explanation.definitionFit: To hallow something is to consecrate it, to set it apart as holy.

clue.text: Where a bite of the apple denied man God's grace

definitions.text: Where a bite of the apple denied man God's grace

indicators.note: a bite takes a small piece out of something, here a run of letters from inside the words

explanation.surface: The garden where tasting forbidden fruit cost humanity divine favour.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across 'apple denied'; the whole clue also describes the garden of Genesis.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis, Adam and Eve lost paradise in this garden after eating the forbidden fruit.

clue.text: No tears when there are no housing costs

definitions.text: when there are no housing costs

explanation.surface: There's nothing to cry about when you pay no rent.
explanation.walkthrough: The first definition is cryptic: a rent is a tear, so being free of rents means no tears.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally, it means without rips; as a phrase it means living somewhere without paying the landlord.

clue.text: Not quite enough money even for a brief trip

parts.note: brief means short
a trip is a stumble, a fall

explanation.surface: Funds won't stretch even to a short holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trip' suggests a journey but is a stumble; 'even for' links.
explanation.definitionFit: A shortfall is a deficit, the amount by which funds fall below what is needed.

clue.text: Pear pur must be included in your old-fashioned treatment

indicators.note: the old word for your has to take the mashed fruit inside it

parts.note: thy is the archaic form of your

indicators.note: pureed fruit is mashed up, so these letters are mashed into a new order

explanation.surface: Mashed pear is a must in your traditional remedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'puree' signals the anagram: the fruit is mashed before being wrapped in the archaic word for 'your'.
explanation.definitionFit: Therapy is a course of treatment for an illness or condition.

clue.text: Relief organisation visibly discomfited and upset

parts.note: someone embarrassed visibly goes red
cross means annoyed or upset

explanation.surface: A charity is plainly embarrassed and distressed.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the international humanitarian body giving aid in war and disaster.

clue.text: Neat calculation produces a fair bit of cash

parts.note: neat means tidy
a sum is an arithmetic calculation

explanation.surface: A tidy piece of arithmetic yields a decent amount of money.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means a considerable amount of money.

clue.text: Ultimately propose to invest the ambassador

indicators.note: to invest is to clothe or surround, so the word for propose wraps round the other piece

parts.note: to propose doing something is to intend it
HE stands for His Excellency, the title of an ambassador

explanation.surface: In the end someone plans to install the envoy.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean finally, after everything has happened.

clue.text: Severely criticised for retiring after everyone else!

indicators.note: read as standing for being in, so the word for after everyone else is put inside the retiring word

parts.note: retiring for the night means going to bed
coming after everyone else is being last

explanation.surface: Someone is slated for going to bed after the rest of the household.
explanation.walkthrough: The insertion has no plain indicator: someone retiring after everyone else is the last one in bed, and the wordplay builds exactly that picture.
explanation.definitionFit: To be blasted is to be attacked fiercely in words, roundly condemned.

clue.text: Spendthrift admits to egging on one society girl

parts.note: to prod is to urge or egg someone on
I is the Roman numeral for one
gal is a casual word for a girl

explanation.surface: A wastrel confesses to urging on a debutante.
explanation.definitionFit: Prodigal means wastefully extravagant, as in the parable's prodigal son.

clue.text: Ridicules men

explanation.surface: Someone mocks the blokes.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means mocks or makes fun of; as a plural noun it means blokes or fellows.

clue.text: Go and go around

explanation.surface: An instruction to set off and circle.
explanation.definitionFit: A turn is a go in a game; to turn is to rotate or spin.

clue.text: Discount to be raised in standard charge

indicators.note: the reversed piece goes inside the word for the charge

parts.note: a rate is a fixed charge or price

indicators.note: in a down clue raised means read upwards, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A reduction is to be added to the usual fee.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'raised' means the little word is read upwards before it goes inside the charge.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebate is a partial refund, money taken off a bill.

clue.text: Who French took to South American city

parts.note: qui is French for who
taken as written

explanation.surface: A Frenchman who took to a city in South America.
explanation.definitionFit: Quito is the capital of Ecuador.

clue.text: A very loud note one hears, causes disturbance

parts.note: ff, fortissimo, is the musical marking for very loud

indicators.note: the note is to be heard, giving its spoken sound rather than its spelling

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A deafening musical sound that you hear creates a commotion.
explanation.definitionFit: An affray is a public fight or brawl that breaks the peace.

clue.text: Take steps to attend a boxing contest

parts.note: to see a show is to attend it
a bout is a boxing match

explanation.surface: Someone acts to go to a prize fight.
explanation.definitionFit: To see about something is to deal with it or make arrangements for it.

clue.text: Soft, luxurious and lavish

explanation.surface: A description of a rich, velvety interior.
explanation.definitionFit: Plush fabric is soft with a long nap; plush also means opulent and expensive.

clue.text: Restore privileges to soldiers in the country

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, are British Army soldiers
a state is a nation or country

explanation.surface: Troops in the nation get their rights back.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinstate someone is to put them back in a former position or entitlement.
